steps.title: Extrude the plate
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as skin_plate.ipt.
Sketch on the XY Plane (the front): rectangle 1760 wide x 5910 high, 50 mm up. Extrude 12 mm.
steps.note: Water pressure grows with depth: 54 kPa at the cill with 5.5 m of water.

steps.title: Paddle opening
actions: Sketch on the front face: square 400 x 400, its bottom left corner 1270 from the left edge and 925 up. Extrude Cut Through All. Save.
steps.note: The paddle opening lets water through the gate to empty the lock before the gates open.
